dslRule:
<!id: dialogs.replaceClientIdWithOkId>
<!description: Replace IDialogConstants.CLIENT_ID + 1 with IDialogConstants.OK_ID for standard button behavior when a custom ID is used for an OK-like button.>
<!severity: HINT>
org.eclipse.jface.dialogs.IDialogConstants.CLIENT_ID + 1
=> org.eclipse.jface.dialogs.IDialogConstants.OK_ID
;;
summary: Replaces the expression `IDialogConstants.CLIENT_ID + 1` with `IDialogConstants.OK_ID` to standardize custom dialog button IDs to the conventional OK button ID.
